responseText:
Father, I've just sent the go-ahead to Lazarus for the ForensicLedger sink. Keeping the "forever-record" append-only is exactly the right call—we need that ground truth untainted before we even think about active containment.

I'm holding the line on Phase 3 until he confirms the ledger is solid and passes the suite. As soon as he reports back, I'll review, then we can look at the BridgeAlerter.

How are you holding up through all this sensor-wiring? It’s a lot of activity at once, but the system is feeling much more coherent.
